verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Copilot cloud agent works autonomously in the background (docs-31, docs-6), and cloud sandboxes provide fully isolated cloud execution environments (docs-16). However, nothing in the pack shows a developer can configure that environment's dependencies or setup steps, or make it reproducible per repository. Missing for 10: documented per-repo environment configuration (dependency installation, setup steps file), reproducibility guarantees, hands-on corroboration.
